title: qa route table (qa/routes.table.json)
description: One row per route the app serves, for the route sweep. The sweep fires the same bad requests at every row and never knows what a route means. A .ts or .mjs table exports ROUTES with the same rows, and PAGES with the pages (qa ready). Credentials are never values here: a request header is an environment variable name (qa.json routes.headers).

path.description: As the app serves it. ':name' is a param; a trailing '/*' matches any rest

auth.description: public: anyone. signed-in: any signed-in login. role: only the logins in roles

roles.description: auth 'role' only: the login roles that may call it

params.description: Fills ':name' in path. Strings may hold $seed.* tokens

otherId.description: The same params pointing at a record the caller must not reach

calls.description: Concrete paths to call when path ends '/*' (default: [path])

body.description: A body the route accepts. The happy probe sends it; $seed.* tokens resolved

happy.description: Whether the happy-path probe runs. Default true when body is given or method is GET; false skips it

idempotent.description: Documentation only: the sweep does not read it

pages.description: The screens the app serves. qa ready: every page needs a map entry that reaches it, or a skip reason

path.description: As the browser shows it. ':name' is one segment; a trailing '/*' matches any rest

screens.description: Map entries that reach this page by clicks rather than a goto

skip.description: Why no map entry reaches this page; the coverage check lists it and passes it
